meta.name: Polymarket Copy-Trade Paper Log
meta.purpose: Separate system from sports betting. Paper-track copied positions (ALL market types) in UNITS to prove the copy edge beats slippage BEFORE real money.
meta.unitNote: 1 unit = $5. You COPY THE SIDE AND PRICE, not the dollar amount. The trader bets their whole bankroll (often $10k-$200k); you stake a flat 1 unit. traderSize = the copied wallet's position size, shown only for context.
meta.rules: Curated slate: copy consensus (2+ top wallets) OR high-conviction positions from the strongest wallets, still copyable near entry. VERIFY sports matchups + dates against the real league schedule before logging (skip stale/old markets). Skip coin-flips and late entries. Grade on CLV-style edge, not just W/L.

plays.market: LoL: T1 vs Karmine Corp - Game 3 Winner
plays.note: WON. 3 top wallets all on T1 at ~83.5c, copied at the same price and it hit. First data point that consensus-copy can work.

plays.market: Game Handicap: TL (-2.5) vs Deep Cross Gaming
plays.note: WON. Consensus-2 eSports handicap (needheal + 0xF201, both held to resolution). TL covered -2.5 and the market settled to 1. Copied at 36.5c (1c above the sharps' 35c), risk 1u to win 1.74u — biggest single-play return of the lab so far. Best evidence yet that consensus-of-2 conviction holds.

plays.market: LoL: Deep Cross Gaming vs Team Liquid - Game 1 Winner
plays.note: WON. needheal (top-3) conviction on Team Liquid; copied slightly BELOW their entry (67.5c vs 68c) and it resolved to 1. Clean single-wallet copy at a better-than-trader price.

plays.market: Will Argentina win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
plays.note: FLAGSHIP of S-Works' favorite-fade book ($198k position). Copyable at 79c - 9c BELOW their 88c entry, a better price than the sharp got. High-prob, low-payout, long hold (July 20).

plays.market: Will Mexico reach the 2026 FIFA World Cup final?
plays.note: The S-Works grind: buy No at 93.5c on a longshot favorite. ~0.07u return, very high hit rate. Shows the risk profile honestly - risk 1u to make a sliver, one upset erases many wins.

plays.market: Will Kylian Mbappe be the top goalscorer at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
plays.note: S-Works fading the single-player favorite for the Golden Boot ($88k). Copyable at 78.5c, ~3c above their 75.5c entry (within tolerance). Fade thesis: even the best striker rarely outscores the whole field.

plays.market: Will France reach the 2026 FIFA World Cup final?
plays.note: S-Works fade on a strong contender ($48k) - the most balanced payout in the book (risk 1u to win 0.57u). Copied at 63.5c, fractionally BELOW their entry. Less of a sure thing than the 90c+ fades, so the price pays more.

plays.market: Wimbledon ATP R1: Shintaro Mochizuki vs Max Basing
